title: WOLF
tagline: Dex is 49 and has joined the WOLF Pack for the first quarter of the year.
blurb: Dex is 49 and has joined the WOLF Pack for the first quarter of the year. Pump O and P, hit SPACE on the lamps and keep the red dots off the board, because three dots means 500 metres on the bike or ski machine in a minute and a half. Miss it, or sneak for the door, and it's a strap for two sessions!
controls: Pump (in a set, on the sled, bike or ski machine, or to break away from a chat)
Beat at the top and bottom of each rep
Start a set, drink, ring the bell, take on the finisher; start and skip on the title
Ask for more weight (after a clean set)
Pause: H resume, B board, M music, Q quit to title

demo.contains: January's session with Stevo: the warm-up, the squat block and the sled.

review.verdict: A cheery workout with a proper punishment at last, but too many rough edges and only three months of it. Worth a spot, not yet a personal best.

quote.text: Three dots and up comes the card: FINISHER TIME

credits.name: Mick Dunsby, Prue Fairley and Norm Crabtree for INK & PAPER
